lines.japanese: ──ずしり！
lines.english: —Weight.

lines.japanese: じわじわ意識と同調してゆく馴染みの感覚より先に、直立している肉体の確かな重みが突然のしかかってきた。五感を取りまく色や雑音、そして痛みが一斉に情報として流れこんでくる。
lines.english: Before familiar sensation could slowly fall into step with consciousness, the undeniable weight of a body standing upright crashed down on me. Color, noise, pain—the data of all five senses came flooding in at once.

lines.japanese: 来た。≪スクランブル≫だ。俺たちは想定外の危急的かつ強制的な交替をそう呼んでいた。
lines.english: Here it was. A *Scramble*. That was our name for an unforeseen, urgent, compulsory changeover.

lines.japanese: そしていま、瞬間的に直感できるほど、俺を取りまく空気が──視線が凝結している。
lines.english: And now I could feel it in an instant: the air around me—the eyes upon me—had frozen solid.

lines.japanese: こういうときに呼ばれるのは俺の役割だからすぐに分かる。事情はともあれ俺たちは、なんらかの身体的窮地に立たされているんだろう。
lines.english: I knew at once. This was the sort of moment they called me in for. Whatever had happened, our body must be in physical danger.

lines.japanese: 「いってえぇぇ……」
lines.english: “Fuuuck, that hurts...”

lines.japanese: 俺はずきずきと痛みを発する患部に手を添える。耳のうしろ、こめかみの辺り。
lines.english: I put a hand to the throbbing spot behind my ear, near the temple.

lines.japanese: ぬらり。指先を濡らすほどの出血はあるが、大して深くない切り傷だ。このぐらいなら傷口を押さえて三分も血を止めてりゃほぼ塞がる。
lines.english: Slick. Enough blood to wet my fingertips, but the cut wasn't deep. Hold it closed and stop the bleeding for three minutes, and something this small would nearly seal itself.

lines.japanese: 頭部の擦過傷は程度のわりに出血量が多いことをさんざん学んでいるから、その点では冷静でいられた。しかし外傷以上に延髄が痛んでいた。交替の際に引きずる予兆と余韻だ。
lines.english: I'd learned often enough that even a minor scrape on the head could bleed spectacularly, so that much didn't rattle me. But my medulla hurt worse than the wound—the warning and lingering aftereffect of a changeover.

lines.japanese: 「くっそ……誰だ、やったのァ……」
lines.english: “Damn it... Who the hell did this...?”

lines.japanese: 俺は片手で傷口を塞ぎながら、≪スクランブル≫でむりやり表に立たされたときはいつも必ずそうするように、まず現状を把握するため前後左右を素早く窺った。
lines.english: One hand sealing the wound, I did what I always did when a *Scramble* forced me to the surface: quickly scanned front, back, left, and right to take stock.

lines.japanese: レストラン……アレキサンダーか。てことは≪コックピット≫にいたのは鷲介だな。
lines.english: A restaurant... Alexander. So Shusuke had been in the *Cockpit*.

lines.japanese: 「ち、千歳さん、大丈夫ですか！？」
lines.english: “M-Mr. Chitose, are you all right!?”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえ」
lines.english: “Shut up.”

lines.japanese: 耳元で喚いてる女の声が、思考の整理に邪魔だった。俺は立ちあがり（どうやら俺はその女に支えられていたらしい、鷲介と親しい仲のようだ）頭を軽く振って焦点を絞った。
lines.english: The woman shrieking in my ear was getting in the way of sorting my thoughts. I stood—she seemed to have been holding me up, which meant she was probably close to Shusuke—and gave my head a small shake to pull the world into focus.

lines.japanese: 生命の危機に瀕して俺が呼びだされたときは、状況の把握より先に敵意や殺意を探すことの方が肝要だ。
lines.english: When they summoned me because our life was at stake, finding hostility or murderous intent mattered more than understanding the circumstances.

lines.japanese: 騒然と立ちどまって目を見はっている野次馬の輪の中、ひとり息を荒げて肩を上下させている男がいた──目深くかぶった帽子のせいでその眼差しは確認できなかったけれど。
lines.english: A ring of gawking bystanders stood frozen, eyes wide. At its center was one man breathing hard, shoulders heaving. A hat pulled low hid his gaze.

lines.japanese: 「……あいつか」
俺は片手で後ろ頭の患部を押さえたまま、もう片方のこぶしを棒のようにまっすぐ前へ突きだして進んだ。
lines.english: Keeping one hand pressed to the wound at the back of my head, I advanced with the other fist thrust straight ahead like a rod.

lines.japanese: 「ま、待って！　危ないですよ！」
lines.english: “W-wait! It's dangerous!”

lines.japanese: 女が俺を引きとめようとしたが、俺には躊躇している暇がない。ともかく目の前で攻撃の意図をひけらかしている外敵が存在するなら、すみやかにそいつを排除・撃退しなくてはならないはずだ。
lines.english: The woman tried to hold me back, but I had no time to hesitate. If an external enemy stood before me flaunting his intent to attack, I had to eliminate or repel him immediately.

lines.japanese: 「野郎、息の根止めたるァァ！」
lines.english: “You bastard! I’ll finish you off!”

lines.japanese: 俺が格闘戦の間合いまで踏みこむと、帽子の男が熊のように両手を広げて飛びかかってきた。俺の体を押したおそうとでも思ったのか。なんだそりゃ、ガキのケンカじゃあるまいに。
lines.english: I stepped into striking distance. The man in the hat spread both arms like a bear and lunged. Was he planning to push me over? What the hell was that? We weren't schoolkids having a scuffle.

lines.japanese: 「アホじゃん」
lines.english: “What an idiot.”

lines.japanese: 俺は呆れるほど素人くさい突撃を片足ひとつでいなすと、たたらを踏んで通りすぎてゆく横っ面に、矢のような一発を刺しこんだ。
lines.english: One step was enough to slip his laughably amateur charge. As he stumbled past, I drove an arrow-swift blow into the side of his face.

lines.japanese: 驚いてる。ぴしりと綺麗に顎へ入ったから、痛みのわりに脳が揺すぶられているはずだ。
lines.english: That surprised him. It had snapped clean against his jaw; his brain would be rattling much harder than the pain suggested.

lines.japanese: 「ふッ！」
lines.english: “Hff!”

lines.japanese: 牽制のつもりで、軽めの二発目をまっすぐに撃った。しかし相手は、俺に牙を剥いたときの狂気めいた雄叫びとは裏腹に、気の毒なほど戦い慣れしていなかった。
lines.english: I threw a lighter second straight as a warning. Yet for all the lunatic howl he'd loosed when he bared his fangs at me, the poor bastard had scarcely ever fought.

lines.japanese: 「うぶぅ！」
lines.english: “Oof!”

lines.japanese: 俺の動きが見えなかったんだろう。やつはろくに避けることもせず、その一撃をまともに腹のド真ん中で受けとめた。
lines.english: He must not have seen me move. He hardly tried to dodge and caught the blow dead center in the gut.

lines.japanese: 「う、ぐっ、うぅぅ……」
lines.english: “Ugh... guh... uhhh...”

lines.japanese: 体を折った男の喉から醜いうめき声がだだ漏れる。
lines.english: An ugly moan spilled unchecked from the doubled-over man's throat.
“Guh... ngh...!”

lines.japanese: やつは一度、帽子の奥から呪うような眼光を俺に放った。しかしそれも一瞬だった。
lines.english: From beneath his hat brim, he shot me one venomous glare. It lasted only an instant.

lines.japanese: 「覚えてろ……」
lines.english: “This isn't over...”

lines.japanese: すぐに背を向けて、よたよたと走りだす。逃げ足さえ遅いやつだった。
lines.english: He immediately turned and staggered into a run. Even his getaway was slow.

lines.japanese: 「んだ、あの激弱えーやつァ……」
lines.english: “What the hell was that? Weak as shit...”

lines.japanese: 俺は重い頭を落として、誰にも聞こえない声で呟いた。
lines.english: I let my heavy head hang and muttered too low for anyone to hear.

lines.japanese: 「腕一本で終わったじゃねえか……こんなんでいちいち≪スクランブル≫かけてんじゃねえよ、へらへら小僧……」
lines.english: “One arm was all it took... Don’t call a *Scramble* over something this pathetic, you grinning little shit...”

lines.japanese: 眩暈がする。血に濡れた髪は生乾きで、手触りが悪かった。
lines.english: The world spun. The blood in my hair had gone tacky as it half dried, unpleasant against my hand.

lines.japanese: 「千歳さん！」
lines.english: “Mr. Chitose!”

lines.japanese: さっきの女と、ゆうべ見たヒゲのおっさんが近づいてくる。
lines.english: The woman from before approached with the bearded older man I'd seen the previous night.

lines.japanese: 俺は首の後ろを這いのぼってくる鈍い痛みに体を委ねることにした。丁度いい。この状況は厄介すぎる。どのみちまだ約束の時間じゃない。操縦桿はやつに返してしまおう。
lines.english: I decided to surrender to the dull pain crawling up the back of my neck. Fine. This situation was too much trouble. It wasn’t my appointed time yet anyway. I might as well hand him back the controls.

lines.japanese: 「おい、おまえ……」
lines.english: “Hey, you...”

lines.japanese: 後頭部を押さえたまま、鷲介と仲の良い女に告げた。
lines.english: Still holding the back of my head, I addressed the woman who seemed close to Shusuke.

lines.japanese: 「これ傷口、水で洗って消毒液で処置しとけ……医者に診せるほどじゃねえから……」
lines.english: “Wash this wound with water and treat it with antiseptic... It isn’t bad enough for a doctor...”

lines.japanese: 「は、はい、分かりました……」
lines.english: “Y-yes. I understand...”

lines.japanese: 女の答えより先に、俺は目を閉じた。波が運ぶ浅瀬の砂に似た重みが、延髄を伝って脳髄へ沁みわたってゆく。
lines.english: I closed my eyes before she finished answering. A heaviness like sand borne over the shallows by a wave traveled along my brain stem and seeped into my mind.

lines.japanese: 俺は意識が途絶える前に、自らその場に尻を落としておいた。交替するときは可能なかぎり、体を座らせるか寝かせるかしておくのが≪取り決め≫だ。
lines.english: Before consciousness cut out, I lowered myself to the floor. The *Agreement* required us to leave the body seated or lying down whenever possible before a changeover.

lines.japanese: 約束の時間は１０時。もちろん俺たちはデジタルな機械じゃない。多少のずれは許容するつもりだ。そんな心の広いことを考えながら、俺は尻餅をついた姿勢で眠りに落ちていった。
lines.english: My appointed time was ten. Naturally, we weren't digital machines. I was prepared to permit a little deviation. Entertaining this magnanimous thought, I fell asleep where I sat on the floor.
